holidays.name: Clean Up Your Room Day
holidays.description: Today is your official excuse to excavate the laundry mountain, find the floor, and rescue the mugs that have been quietly growing science projects. It's a day for tidying up and for finally admitting how many chargers you really own.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance of unclear origin. It has long been listed as a light-hearted calendar day in early-to-mid May, a natural fit for spring cleaning season.
holidays.funFact: Many people say a tidy space helps them think more clearly, so a 15-minute tidy-up counts as a tiny productivity hack.

holidays.name: National Shrimp Day
holidays.description: A day to celebrate one of the most popular seafoods around. Scampi, cocktail, tempura, tacos, or a classic shrimp boil all count. Peel, dip, and devour.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial food observance of unclear origin. It is part of the modern calendar of seafood and snack celebrations.
holidays.funFact: Shrimp are among the most-consumed seafood in the United States, and a shrimp's heart is located in its head.

holidays.name: Trust Your Intuition Day
holidays.description: Today encourages you to listen to your gut feelings. Pick the restaurant, take the turn, or say yes (or no) to that hunch without overthinking it.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance of unclear origin. It falls on the same date as several other whimsical May observances.
holidays.funFact: The gut contains hundreds of millions of neurons, which is why it's often nicknamed the body's "second brain."
